Class ScenarioEventsSectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.scenario.ScenarioEventsSectionBuilder
public class ScenarioEventsSectionBuilder extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller and Section Builder for Historical Planetary Events and Climate Drifts.

Extracted from ScenarioSetupPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Constructs the events scheduling calendar, table columns, localized event type converters, and loads empirical volcanic, seismic, climatic, and historical leader interventions.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
